title: ITSP.10.171 authorized media types and identifiable owners need enforcement evidence
remediation: The sponsor endpoint and information custodians define restricted or prohibited media types and permitted uses. Review effective access controls and verify a removable item with no identifiable owner is refused, using a harmless fixture or an authorized implementation record. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect approved media restrictions, effective settings and redacted authorized and ownerless media decisions
